title: Innovative integration of molecular docking and machine learning for drug discovery: from virtual screening to nanomolar inhibitors.
one_liner_zh: 该综述聚焦分子对接与机器学习整合的药物发现流程，虽涉及蛋白-配体互作建模，但对象为小分子抑制剂而非蛋白质-DNA互作，方法可迁移性有限，与TF-DNA课题关联较弱。
abstract: This review highlights our group's systematic approach to integrating molecular docking, pharmacophore modeling, and machine learning methodologies for the rational discovery of bioactive leads. We describe innovative strategies including docking-based data augmentation, ligand-receptor contact fingerprints, genetic algorithm-guided feature selection, and SHAP-based model interpretation. These approaches have enabled the discovery of nanomolar inhibitors against multiple therapeutic targets including STAT3, TTK, LSD-1, and HER2. The presented workflow demonstrates how machine learning (ML) can be synergistically combined with traditional computer-aided drug design methods to achieve efficient scaffold hopping and identify novel chemotypes with potent biological activities.
abstract_zh: 本综述重点介绍了我们课题组在整合分子对接、药效团建模及机器学习方法以合理发现生物活性先导化合物方面的系统性研究。我们描述了创新策略，包括基于对接的数据增强、配体-受体接触指纹、遗传算法引导的特征选择以及基于SHAP的模型解释。这些方法已成功发现针对多个治疗靶点（包括STAT3、TTK、LSD-1和HER2）的纳摩尔级抑制剂。所呈现的工作流程展示了机器学习（ML）如何与传统计算机辅助药物设计方法协同结合，以实现高效的骨架跃迁并识别具有强效生物活性的新型化学型。
